item.description:

  • 日本語名: みちくさ～Loitering on the way～
  • 英語名: Michikusa Loitering on the Way

あらすじ

One day, when Chiaki is on the train, the train suddenly stops for unknown reasons. However, all passengers remain calm since this kind of thing often happens. Of course, he is also calm and thinks about how he kills time. At that moment, he finds a girl walking along the train tracks….

item.title: Kimi no Katachi ga Utsuru
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: TAKE OUT
  • 発売日: 2007-03-30
  • スコア: なし (1 人評価)
  • 日本語名: きみのかたちがうつる
  • 英語名: Kimi no Katachi ga Utsuru

あらすじ

Main character is a ghost member of science club. One day he is called by his sempai to investigate mysterious scientific phenomenon at school. He goes with two friends at night school and witnesses some male and female students have sex there. On the next morning it turns out that that at night there was a phenomenon of mirrors. There are various rumors about doppelgangers, death, happiness and other dimensions linked to the mirrors. The investigation is only beginning.

item.title: Tesuta ~Teach & Study~
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: TAKE OUT
  • 発売日: 2006-11-02
  • スコア: なし (1 人評価)
  • 日本語名: てすた～Teach＆Study～
  • 英語名: Tesuta Teach & Study

别名

  • TeStu

あらすじ

Naoki is a high school student. His parents are abroad on business, and he enjoys living alone. As a result, his midterm exams are terrible, and his father, who comes back temporarily, gets mad to see it. His father decides to put him in a school dormitory if Naoki doesn’t take good results in the end-of-term exams. His father hires a tutor for him, and a beautiful girl comes to his house as a tutor. Her name is Yuko, never had tutor experience. When they are studying, she suddenly pushes him and sits astride him and…. His hard study life starts like this… involving his old friend, Kazumi….

item.title: Yuuwakuppoi!
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: TAKE OUT
  • 発売日: 2006-06-23
  • スコア: 6.21/10 (8 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 誘惑っぽい！
  • 英語名: Yuuwakuppoi!

あらすじ

Main character is an ordinary student who has a crush on Mio. One day he has a lunch on the roof when gust of wind flips Mio’s skirt revealing her secret part unprotected by underwear. Mio hurries to run away, but protagonist can’t stop thinking about girl’s reason for not wearing pants. When he comes to the room another day, Mio voluntarily reveals her secret part. That opens a door to new extraordinary secret school life.

item.title: Minyo! 2 ~Kondo wa Shamusho~
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: TAKE OUT
  • 発売日: 2005-03-18
  • スコア: なし (3 人評価)
  • 日本語名: みにょっ！2～今度は社務所～
  • 英語名: Minyo! 2 Kondo wa Shamusho

あらすじ

Main character takes a part-time job at the shrine in his hometown with his childhood friend during summer vacations. However, this shrine is rumored as evil. Priest gets hospitalized after an incident with spirit exorcism. Protagonist becomes the only man among the cheerful and lovely shrine maidens. But evil spirits still loom above the shrine. Main character finds his own way of exorcism - sex ritual.

When he knows Kasumi is engaged to Yoshio who is the worst teacher at school, the story starts to ….

item.title: Imohori ~Onii-chan no Funtouki!~
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: TAKE OUT
  • 発売日: 2004-03-26
  • スコア: なし (3 人評価)
  • 日本語名: いもほり～お兄ちゃんの奮闘記！～
  • 英語名: Imohori Onii-chan no Funtouki!

别名

  • いもほり～お兄ちゃんの奮闘記！～

あらすじ

Main character is half-engaged with another university student, but for formal engagement he needs her father’s approval. Alas, father went on a business trip for a week. Protagonist wants to take advantage of his fiance at the winter vacations, so he is limited in time. He decides to live this week at their house. But he could not foresee all the seduction attempts from the members of the family…
